description: (Na)₂CrAgF₆ crystallizes in the cubic Fm̅3m space group. The structure consists of eight Na clusters inside a CrAgF₆ framework. In each Na cluster, Na is bonded in a 12-coordinate geometry to  atoms. In the CrAgF₆ framework, Cr is bonded to six equivalent F atoms to form CrF₆ octahedra that share corners with six equivalent AgF₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedra are not tilted. All Cr-F bond lengths are 1.92 Å. Ag is bonded to six equivalent F atoms to form AgF₆ octahedra that share corners with six equivalent CrF₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedra are not tilted. All Ag-F bond lengths are 2.35 Å. F is bonded in a linear geometry to one Cr and one Ag atom.
